summary.intent: Complete Phase 21 (byo-ipfs-node-support) by implementing BYO IPFS node support with performance baselines, then verify and formally close the phase.
summary.outcome: All 4 gap closure plans (21-08 through 21-11) completed successfully. Phase 21 verified with 5/5 automated checks passing and approved by user, with phase marked complete in ROADMAP and STATE.

repo: BYO pinning reduces CipherBox API load by 98% per file compared to standard flow
BYO pin p50 latency is 2.0s — +47% median latency vs local Kubo but with better tail latency
PinningConfig type was not exported from @cipherbox/sdk and required a fix
PinataProvider uses native v3 API and required registration in the load test client-pool
TEE-routed connection tests use ECIES-encrypted credentials with server-side probing to avoid CORS
Phase verification reports are stored at .planning/phases/<phase-name>/<phase-id>-VERIFICATION.md
workflow: Phase completion requires both automated verification (5/5 must-haves) and explicit human approval for items requiring live sessions
Auto-fixed deviations during implementation were tracked and counted per plan
Phase state is tracked in both ROADMAP and STATE files, committed together at phase close

friction: PinningConfig type missing from @cipherbox/sdk export required an unplanned fix during 21-08
